node_check._comment_enabled: Enable GPU visibility, AMDGPU/KFD, kernel-health, and ROCm validation.
node_check._comment_gpus_per_node: Exact number of AMD GPUs expected on every node.
node_check._comment_expected_rocm_version: Expected ROCm version across all cluster nodes. Must match the output of 'amd-smi version' on all nodes. Format: 'major.minor.patch' (e.g., '6.2.0', '5.7.1').

ping_check._comment: ICMP ping reachability from the CVS driver host to every cluster node. Diagnostic only, opt-in, disabled by default.
ping_check._comment_count: Number of ICMP echo requests per node (ping -c).

uptime_check._comment: Informational 'uptime' collection across nodes. Never gates preflight status. Opt-in, disabled by default.

etc_hosts._comment: /etc/hosts consistency against the cluster inventory (WARNING at worst). Opt-in, disabled by default.
etc_hosts._comment_extra_entries: Optional list of {hostname, ip} pairs that must match exactly in /etc/hosts, in addition to validating that every cluster node address has some entry.

limits_conf._comment: /etc/security/limits.conf validation (blocking FAIL when enabled). Opt-in, disabled by default.
limits_conf._comment_required_lines: Exact lines that must be present (in any order, whitespace-insensitive) in /etc/security/limits.conf on every node.

nic_driver_version._comment: Per-vendor NIC driver version + provenance validation. Activate one or more vendor sub-blocks via nic_type. Opt-in, disabled by default.
nic_driver_version._comment_nic_type: One or more of: ainic, broadcom, mellanox. Selects which vendor sub-block(s) below actually run. A node lacking the selected vendor's hardware is reported SKIPPED, not FAILed.

ainic._comment_expected_fw_version: Expected AINIC per-NIC version -- both the 'Uboot-A' and 'Firmware-A' fields from 'nicctl show version firmware' must match this value. nicctl is installed alongside the AINIC driver.

broadcom._comment_expected_package_version: Expected Broadcom NIC package version -- the 'Active Package Version' field from 'niccli -i <idx> show --pkg_ver'. niccli is installed alongside the Broadcom driver package and does not report kernel module (modinfo) version at all.

mellanox._comment: NEW, UNVALIDATED against real Mellanox hardware -- no bash/ansible source material exists to port from; designed by analogy to the broadcom/ainic sub-blocks.
mellanox._comment_expected_mlx5_core_version: Expected mlx5_core kernel module version (modinfo -F version mlx5_core).

ssh_mesh._comment: All-pairs passwordless SSH reachability mesh across reachable cluster nodes (WARNING at worst). Opt-in, disabled by default.
ssh_mesh._comment_ssh_timeout_sec: Per-connection SSH timeout in seconds used for each node-to-node probe.

rdma._comment: RDMA connectivity testing parameters using ibv_rc_pingpong (direct IB verbs) for RCCL-compatible testing
rdma._comment_connectivity_mode: RDMA connectivity testing mode. Options: 'basic' (test adjacent node pairs, fast, ~14% coverage for 8 nodes), 'full_mesh' (test all possible node pairs, comprehensive, 100% coverage), 'skip' (skip RDMA connectivity testing entirely).
rdma._comment_gid_index: GID index to check on all RDMA interfaces. Typically '3' for RoCE (RDMA over Converged Ethernet). Must be a valid GID index for your InfiniBand/RoCE setup.
rdma._comment_interfaces: List of specific RDMA interface names that should be present on all cluster nodes. Examples: ['rocep28s0', 'rocep62s0'] for standard setup, ['mlx5_0', 'mlx5_1'] for Mellanox, ['ib0', 'ib1'] for generic InfiniBand.
rdma._comment_nodes_per_full_mesh_group: Number of nodes in each full-mesh partition group for parallel RDMA testing (2-128). Smaller groups use fewer resources per node but require more rounds. Adjust based on cluster size and resource constraints.
rdma._comment_ibv_test_timeout: Timeout in seconds for each ibv_rc_pingpong connectivity test. Uses ibv_rc_pingpong (direct IB verbs) instead of rping for RCCL-compatible testing. Increase for slower networks or high-latency connections.
rdma._comment_ibv_test_port_range: Port range for ibv_rc_pingpong tests to avoid conflicts. Format: 'start-end' (e.g., '10000-50000', '10000-10999'). Ensure ports are not blocked by firewalls.
rdma._comment_inter_full_mesh_group_pairs_per: Max ordered full-mesh group-pairs (Gi→Gj keys) per wave during inter-group RDMA testing. 'auto' calculates as max(1, num_groups - 1). Can be set to a specific integer to control wave size and reduce memory/CPU load.
rdma._comment_prune_failure_threshold: Prune nodes whose fraction of peers with ≥1 FAIL intra test is ≥ this value. Range: 0.0 to 1.0 (0.5 = 50% failure threshold). Helps remove problematic nodes before inter-group testing. Lower values (0.2-0.3) are more aggressive.
rdma._comment_port_retry_max: Max retry attempts for pairs whose logs show PORT_LISTEN_FAILED. Range: 0-10 retries with new TCP ports after each wave. Helps handle port conflicts during large-scale testing.
rdma._comment_port_retry_gap: Port gap when remapping ports for PORT_LISTEN_FAILED retries. Range: 1-65535. Starts at (max port in batch) + this gap to reduce overlap with ephemeral ports.
rdma._comment_exclude_failed_interface_nodes: Legacy hint for reporting: preflight now prunes interface/GID-failed nodes from the SSH host list automatically. Interface failures are excluded from mesh testing regardless of this flag.

ifoe._comment: IFoE L2 connectivity testing via 'afmctl test ping'. Opt-in: defaults to 'skip'.
ifoe._comment_connectivity_mode: IFoE L2 ping mode. Options: 'run' (execute afmctl L2 ping on every reachable node) or 'skip' (default; preflight will not invoke afmctl). Enable once afmctl and the IFoE driver are available on every node.
ifoe._comment_afmctl_path: Absolute path or PATH-resolved name of the afmctl binary on each cluster node. Examples: 'afmctl', '/usr/local/bin/afmctl'.
ifoe._comment_use_sudo: When true, afmctl is invoked with sudo. Enable if afmctl needs root on the cluster image.
ifoe._comment_bdf_discovery: How to determine which accelerator BDFs to ping on each node. 'auto' runs 'afmctl show device' on each node and uses the BDFs reported there. 'config' uses only the explicit 'bdfs' list below.
ifoe._comment_bdfs: Optional explicit list of accelerator BDFs (e.g. ['0001:01:00.1']) shared across the cluster. Leave empty to defer to bdf_discovery='auto'.
ifoe._comment_dst_accelerators: Destination accelerator IDs passed to --dst-accelerator. One afmctl ping is issued per (bdf, dst_accelerator). Use [0] for a single-accelerator destination; use a list like [0, 1] to ping multiple peers.
ifoe._comment_ports: Ports passed to -p. Use 'all' (default; omits -p so afmctl tests every port), a string like '0,1,2' or '0-7', or a list [0,1,2].
ifoe._comment_pings_per_port: Value for -c (pings per port pair). Larger values smooth over transient losses.
ifoe._comment_per_ping_timeout: Optional value for afmctl's -t flag (per-ping timeout). Leave null to use afmctl's default.
ifoe._comment_traffic_types: Traffic categories to enforce when evaluating PASS/FAIL. Maps to afmctl's --traffic-type (request, response, non-ifoe). When all three are selected (default) --traffic-type is omitted so afmctl exercises every category.
ifoe._comment_loss_threshold_pct: Maximum tolerated packet loss percentage per traffic type. Defaults to 0.0 (any failure marks the node as FAIL).
ifoe._comment_ssh_timeout: Overall SSH timeout (seconds) for each afmctl invocation. Increase for large port counts or high pings_per_port values.
ifoe._comment_fabric_checks: Add AIFM/AFM/vPOD, station-mask, and IFoE port admission to node health.
ifoe._comment_policy: CVS owns afmctl discovery, privilege handling, BDF and port discovery, strict coverage, traffic selection, and timeout derivation.

l2ping._comment: Strict afmctl L2 connectivity gate executed before TransferBench and RDMA
l2ping._comment_pings_per_port: Ping samples sent per selected IFoE port pair.

transferbench._comment: TransferBench IFoE data-path validation executed before RDMA
transferbench._comment_scope: Run independent tests per node or one multi-rank cluster test. Options: node, cluster.
transferbench._comment_profile: CVS-supported TransferBench validation profile. Currently: smoketest.
transferbench._comment_message_sizes: Message sizes exercised by the selected profile.
transferbench._comment_iterations: Validated iterations per test and message size.

nic_firmware._comment: Per-vendor NIC firmware/host-software validation. Activate one or more vendor sub-blocks via nic_type. Opt-in, disabled by default.
nic_firmware._comment_nic_type: One or more of: ainic, broadcom, mellanox. Selects which vendor sub-block(s) below actually run.

ainic._comment_expected_nic_count: Exact number of AINIC RDMA devices expected on every node (FAIL on mismatch). Unchanged from today's shipped behavior: no per-node vendor-presence SKIP for AINIC -- see Design decisions.
ainic._comment_expected_fw_version: Expected AINIC firmware version (WARNING on mismatch).
ainic._comment_expected_host_version: Expected AINIC host-software version (WARNING on mismatch).

broadcom._comment: NEW: not present in the original ansible/ainicfwcheck/fwcheck.yml (AINIC-only). Adds symmetric firmware validation for Broadcom NICs, detected per-node so mixed fleets don't false-FAIL on non-Broadcom nodes.
broadcom._comment_expected_nic_count: Exact number of Broadcom NIC devices expected on every node with Broadcom hardware present (FAIL on mismatch), counted via 'niccli --list' (requires sudo). Note: a dual-port card shows up as 2 rows/devices, one per PCI function -- e.g. 8 dual-port cards = 16.
broadcom._comment_expected_fw_version: Expected Broadcom NIC firmware version -- the 'FwVersion' column from 'niccli --list' (WARNING on mismatch). niccli is installed alongside the Broadcom driver.

mellanox._comment: NEW, UNVALIDATED against real Mellanox hardware -- no bash/ansible source material exists to port from; designed by analogy to the ainic/broadcom sub-blocks.
mellanox._comment_expected_nic_count: Exact number of Mellanox mlx5 RDMA devices expected on every node with Mellanox hardware present (FAIL on mismatch).
mellanox._comment_expected_fw_version: Expected Mellanox NIC firmware version, e.g. from 'mlxfwmanager --query' or 'ethtool -i <mlx5 iface>' firmware-version field (WARNING on mismatch).

pfc_qos_dcqcn._comment: AINIC PFC/QoS/DCQCN control-plane validation via 'nicctl'. Blocking FAIL gate when enabled, run alongside the IFoE L2/TransferBench gates. Opt-in, disabled by default. All golden values are generic AINIC defaults and fully overridable per deployment.

pfc._comment_expected_card_count: Number of AINIC cards expected to report PFC state on every node.
pfc._comment_expected_pause_type: Expected pause/flow-control type reported per card.

qos._comment_expected_card_count: Number of AINIC cards expected to report QoS state on every node.
qos._comment_dscp46_purpose: Expected traffic-class label/purpose associated with DSCP 46.
qos._comment_pfc_no_drop_priorities: Expected no-drop priority list under PFC.

dcqcn._comment_expected_device_count: Number of AINIC devices expected to report DCQCN state on every node.
dcqcn._comment_cnp_dscp: Expected DSCP value used for CNP (Congestion Notification Packet) marking.

reporting._comment_generate_html_report: Whether to generate detailed HTML report. Set to 'false' to disable HTML report generation.
reporting._comment_artifacts_root_dir: Root directory for preflight artifacts. HTML reports are saved here, and RDMA full_mesh ScriptLet logs use <artifacts_root_dir>/rdma_connectivity_workspace/<session>/<round>/ on each node (NFS-friendly). Must be writable by the user running the tests.
reporting._comment_generate_rdma_pairs_csv: Whether to generate CSV file with failed RDMA pairs alongside HTML report. Set to 'false' to disable CSV generation. Useful for analyzing connectivity patterns and failures.

debug._comment_scriptlet: Enable ScriptLet debug mode: preserve generated scripts/logs on remote nodes. For RDMA connectivity, wraps each ibv_rc_pingpong server in strace with per-test traces under /tmp/preflight/strace_server_<iface>_<port>.log. WARNING: Can be expensive at scale due to strace overhead.
